SD14-004.name: DarkZiga-Wasp
SD14-004.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

SD14-003.name: Inegobatta
SD14-003.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void to any of your Spirit.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: During this battle, the opponent can't use White Magic cards.

SD14-008.name: Insects Assemble
SD14-008.effect:
[Flash]
Refresh three "Parasite" family Spirits you control.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Destroy an opposing Cost 3 or less Spirit.

SD14-002.name: Takeyanma
SD14-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
Refresh a "Parasite" family Spirit you control.
[Rush: Blue]
(While you have a Blue symbol, the following effect activates next)
[Blue Core]: Destroy an opposing Cost 2 or less Spirit.

SD14-005.name: Tarancedar
SD14-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2]
When putting cores from the Void to this Spirit, put +1 core.

SD14-X01.name: The ArmoredWoodGod Herac-Dinus
SD14-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When this Spirit, or your Spirit with [High Speed] attacks, unless the opponent blocks with two Spirits, they can't block. When those Spirits block, choose one of them to battle against.

[LV2][LV3]
All your "Parasite" family Spirits gain +2000 BP.

SD14-007.name: The FlyingBeetle Nitoukuwagata
SD14-007.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Brave card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Brave must also be from the Reserve.

[When Braved] (When Battles)
At the end of battle, put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

SD14-001.name: The SpearSoldier Antman
SD14-001.effect:
[LV2] (When Attacks)
For each core in your Reserve, this Spirit gains +1000 BP.

SD14-006.name: The TwinBladeInsect Nokogirafa
SD14-006.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
The opponent exhausts two Spirits they control.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Put a core from the Void each to two Spirits with [High Speed] you control.
